cands.name: Mitch Rosenwald
cands.bio: Democratic state representative for HD 98 since 2024. Licensed clinical social worker and Barry University social work professor; Oakland Park mayor (2023-2024) and city commissioner (2020-2024).
cands.local_ties: Moved to Florida in 2007; Oakland Park officeholder (Wikipedia).

record.text: Oakland Park commissioner elected 2020; mayor 2023-2024; won the 2026 HD 98 Democratic primary against three opponents.

cands.gaps: Unopposed; bills, money, endorsements, social links not researched. Owner-source search (Stew Peters / Alex Jones / Owen Shroyer) not run for this candidate: the research tool's search budget was exhausted before it could be run. No hits is NOT confirmed.
